text:
Sasha: Quick follow-up from yesterday's incident. I want a tighter postmortem follow-up flow and a clearer IC rotation so remediation items don't get stale.
Kevin: Sounds good. We had a bunch of open items that never got tracked after T+7.
Maria: Can we define a short closure checklist and a stale threshold? Makes it easier to audit.
Sasha: Draft flow: T0 = incident declared. T+24h = owner assigned + short RCA summary. T+72h = remediation plan with owners, ETAs, and risk level. T+7 = progress checkpoint. T+14 = verification + attach test evidence. T+30 = closure review + recurrence/pattern analysis.
Aj: Add automated nudges at T+24, T+72, T+7, T+14, T+30. ops-bot should post an ownership snapshot and mark items stale after 7 days with no updates.
ops-bot: OpsTracker scheduled: reminders at T+24h, T+72h, T+7d, T+14d, T+30d for thread 1880509999. Items with no status update in 7d will be flagged STALE.
Priya: IC rotation idea: monthly rota among on-call leads with a "shadow IC" who takes over if the primary IC is out. Require an inline IC handoff note.
Kevin: Put the handoff template here so it's easy to copy:
```
IC Handoff Template:
- Outgoing IC: name
- Incoming IC: name (shadow: name)
- Current state: 2-3 bullets
- Open actions: owner + ETA + risk
- Escalation ladder: who to ping for infra/DB/security
- Next sync: datetime (TZ)
```
Maria: Closure checklist suggestion (must be met to close an action): owner confirms fix deployed, automated smoke test link attached, postmortem doc updated, and recurrence mitigations noted.
Sasha: Also propose an "escalate-to-SRE" rule: if an action is STALE for >7d and owner unresponsive, escalate to on-call manager and assign temporary owner.
Aj: Weekly 15m remediation triage (optional) for actions older than 7 days. Keep it timeboxed.
Nora: For pattern detection, at T+30 tag incidents with the same signature and open a pattern ticket for Research/Infra. Add a short summary of repeated error messages to the postmortem.
Priya: External comms: keep status updates active until mitigation confirmed. Post a one-paragraph customer-facing summary within 72h and the full postmortem after closure. Legal/Comms on cc for regulated accounts.
Kevin: Can we add soft SLAs: P1 ack in 12h, mitigation plan by 72h, mitigation in 7d if feasible? Mark as pilot guidance for 60-90 days.
Sasha: I'll draft a single-page runbook: cadence, IC rota (with shadow roles), stale rules, ops-bot reminder config, closure checklist, and escalation ladder. Will drop it in #eng-oncall and enable the OpsTracker board for pilot incidents.
Aj: I'll volunteer for the pilot rota.
Priya: Me too.
Maria: OpsTracker: please create a board view filtered by incident tag so remediation owners can see all open items and stale flags.
ops-bot: Created board "Incident Remediations - Pilot" filtered tag:incident AND status:open. STALE items show in a separate swimlane.
Sasha: Thanks everyone. I'll post the runbook by EOD and ping volunteers to confirm the pilot list.
